meta-description: How to measure a room for carpet: wall to wall, closets, stairs per tread, plus the 12-foot-roll math that makes estimates differ. Free in-home measure.
post-summary: October 22, 2026 · Measure wall to wall, include every closet, add ten percent for waste — then meet the 12-foot roll, which is why two honest estimates on the same house can be hundreds of dollars apart. How carpet is really measured, where quotes quietly diverge, and why our free measure ends with a written price the same visit.
